principle: OBJECT TYPE != INDIVIDUAL OBJECT != OWNER != LOCATION != CURRENT CONDITION
rules: A unique persistent object keeps object_id through transfer, theft, loss, recovery, repair, damage and relocation.
Changing owner or location never creates a new object.
Damage or repair changes state/history rather than base identity.
Mass-produced interchangeable inventory may remain aggregate/non-unique until a gameplay reason materializes a specific persistent instance.
Materializing a unique instance from aggregate stock must preserve inventory accounting.
AI and presentation layers may not invent ownership, provenance or modifications.
